description: Permanently deactivate an API key. This is irreversible -- the key immediately stops working for all API requests. Use social_api_list_keys to find the key_id. Revoking an already-revoked key is a no-op (idempotent). Does not affect other active keys for the same user.

key_id.description: ID of the API key to revoke

name: social_api_revoke_key
title: Revoke API Key
